Kevin (Support): FYI — customer AcmeInc opened ticket #54321 asking for an incremental webhook style for partial/completions + function-call outputs. They want tokens/JSON fragments delivered to their webhook in near-realtime so their UI can render progressively.
Sam (Eng): Can you paste the ticket body? is this about streaming from our API -> then webhook (server->server)? or their browser to our API?
Kevin (Support): Server->server. They currently poll our /responses endpoint and want push. Quote from ticket: 'We need partial structured events for tool calls so we can show actions as they occur. Prefer a compact SSE-ish format that keeps each event parseable on its own.'
Anya (Product): Assign priority? Seems customer is on Dedicated and willing to pay for early access. This is a good candidate for a gated add-on. Thoughts on compatibility with existing streaming semantics? :eyes:
Luke (Sales): AcmeInc runs live dashboards for customers. If we offer webhook streaming they will convert to dedicated contract. High ARR motion. +1 to early access.
Sam (Eng): Technical/questions: 1) Do they need function-call events interleaved with plain text tokens? 2) Do they require exactly-once semantics or best-effort is fine? 3) How should we handle partial JSON for structured outputs — do we send chunks that are each parseable JSON, or send incremental diffs with an envelope?
Kevin (Support): Their note: interleaved events (tool_call_start, tool_call_fragment, tool_call_end) preferred. They asked for guaranteed ordering; dupes are tolerable if idempotent.
Anya (Product): Proposed scope for triage: MVP that supports server->webhook incremental events for chat/completions and function/tool calls. Must-haves: opt-in per-customer, documented event schema, reassembly guidance, and a graceful fallback to full payload on failure. Nice-to-have: delivery ack webhook, replay window.
Sam (Eng): Quick sketch of event envelope (proposal):
```
{
  "event_id": "uuid",
  "seq": 12,
  "type": "tool_call_fragment",
  "call_id": "uuid",
  "payload": "{...partial json fragment...}",
  "final": false
}
```
Each event should be individually parseable (no need to stitch inside one event). Client reassembles ordering by seq + call_id.
Luke (Sales): Customer also asked for minimal bandwidth — so recommend compact payloads (no verbose model metadata per event). They expect <200ms inter-event latency.
Sam (Eng): Implementation considerations: runtime needs to stream from model KV-cache output -> router -> webhook sink. We need back-pressure handling (if customer webhook is slow), retry policy, ordering guarantees across retries, and a shed-to-batched-full-payload fallback. Rough effort: 3-5 engineer-weeks + infra changes for webhook sink and delivery logs + e2e tests.
Anya (Product): Acceptance criteria (draft):
- AC1: Customer can opt-in to incremental webhooks per API key and receive interleaved token and function-call events.
- AC2: Each event is standalone JSON and includes ordering metadata (seq, event_id, call_id).
- AC3: For network/backpressure failures, we retry with backoff and if delivery cannot be completed within replay-window, we send a final "complete" event with full response payload.
- AC4: Observability: per-request delivery metrics exposed in Console (latency, retries, dropped events).
- AC5: Backwards-compat: existing streaming clients receive no behavioral change unless opt-in.
Sam (Eng): Good. Also add load-shedding SLA: for Dedicated customers we can provide SLO for delivery latency under expected throughput; for hosted we may rate-limit.
Kevin (Support): Customer asks for sample payloads to validate client implementation. Can we produce a spec + test harness?
Sam (Eng): We'll ship a spec + a small test server script (Node/Express SSE) and a CLI utility that simulates partial events and verifies reassembly. Low-effort.
Anya (Product): Prioritization: propose incubate as a Q2 initiative for Dedicated & Private customers, gated behind a small pilot. If pilot successful, roll to hosted as opt-in add-on. Estimate timeline: RFC this week, eng spike next sprint, pilot in 6 weeks.
Luke (Sales): I'll coordinate pilot customer list (AcmeInc + 1 more). They want an NDA for SDK.
ops-bot: Ticket #54321 created in support-tool by Kevin — linked to this thread.
Sam (Eng): Risks: ordered delivery across retries is tricky. We should keep call-level monotonic seq and make payload idempotent. Also ensure we don't leak sensitive metadata in each event.
Anya (Product): Next steps:
1) Sam to post an RFC with the event schema + failure modes by EOD Tue.
2) Kevin to collect precise latency/ordering SLAs from AcmeInc and confirm their webhook URI patterns.
3) Luke to secure pilot NDAs and add to pilot roster.
4) Product to schedule a 30-min triage sync Wed 10:30am.
Sam (Eng): Got it — I'll include sample Node + Python harness and a cut of Console UX for toggling opt-in.
Kevin (Support): I'll update ticket and ping AcmeInc for SLA details.
Anya (Product): :thumbsup: Thanks all — let's capture this as product/backlog item once RFC lands.
Luke (Sales): +1. Luke out.
Kevin (Support): closing loop here — updated ticket and linked RFC once Sam posts it.
Sam (Eng): RFC posted: https://redwood.example/rfcs/incremental-webhook-events (draft)
Anya (Product): will add to roadmap board (initiative: streaming-delivery) and assign PM.
ops-bot: Reminder: triage sync Wed 10:30am in #product-calendar.
